summary: lil-bench: benchmark a running container and upload the result
compatibility: No user action required; lil-bench runs only when started with docker exec.
details: docker exec -it -e LIL_BENCH_TOKEN=<identifier> <container> lil-bench runs the standard test: p2pmark, prefill 32k and 128k, and decode at C1/C8/C16 with 0/64k/128k context. It records the exact serving command, the hardware and PCIe topology, and GPU clocks and throttling.
The identifier comes from docker.local-inference-lab.ai/bench/token (GitHub sign-in). Uploaded runs are private to their author.
